decisions.reason: Commission and ticket counts do not change which referral identifiers are valid or whether self-referrals are allowed.
The source decision does not change the NFT token serial used as the referral code or any referral-code display location.
The current landing-page state does not retain the obsolete six-ticket no-referral rule, and its general referral-entry wording remains valid unchanged.
The source changes ticket and commission issuance counts, not which metadata fields are visible or the source of the referral-code attribute.
Changing issuance counts does not alter how referral identity, badges, book access, or existing ticket state transfer with an NFT.
The source decision does not change email delivery, notification channels, or required transactional-email contents.
The decision changes the number and coverage of commission allocations, not the mint price, commission amount, founder share, or prize-pool split.
